purpose: Template for a Puzzle Memories edit-route run. Copy this file and tasks.json into Pipelines/UnityUIAssets/runs/<new-run>/, then replace the three paths. Absolute paths, or paths relative to the run folder.
ref_dir: REPLACE: folder that contains Screens/*.png (the private mockups)
baseline_manifest: REPLACE: manifest.json of the previous pack (V5)
baseline_root: REPLACE: root folder of the previous pack (contains Unity/)
